description: Schedule the Speak AI meeting assistant to join and record an online meeting (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, or Webex). The assistant joins as a participant other attendees can see, at meetingDate or right away when meetingDate is omitted. Recorded minutes are charged to the account, and on trial plans each scheduled meeting uses one meeting from the allowance.

folderId.description: Folder ID to store the recording in

meetingDate.description: ISO 8601 datetime for when the meeting starts

meetingLanguage.description: Transcription language code for the meeting (e.g. en-US)

meetingURL.description: URL of the meeting to join

name: schedule_meeting_event

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Schedule AI Meeting Assistant
